textRun.content: Round 1
Source: P&E Leads Weekly, Aug 4
Condensed from Michael Wang's questions in the meeting. Questions that were answered live are omitted; related follow-ups are grouped as sub-bullets.
1. Agent Native goalposts
What is the primary Agent Native goal, and what concrete goalposts are we building toward?
What does success mean across developer adoption, enterprise internal tooling, and GTM-function adoption?
What alternative paths did we consider for achieving the same goal?
2. Prioritization rule
What durable prioritization rule should we use when roadmap items serve different user segments?
Who wins when enterprise and self-serve needs diverge?
What do we explicitly defer?
What should we communicate so teams can generate ideas without relitigating the strategy?
3. Primary user and market focus
Who is the primary user or Builder we are optimizing for, and who are their users?
Are we building a broad horizontal framework or selecting a first user and use-case wedge?
What is the shared core across individual builders, enterprise teams, and functional teams?
Which segment-specific needs are intentionally out of scope for now?
4. End-to-end app-building flow
What is the end-to-end experience for creating and deploying an Agent Native app?
Should a user start with a standalone app or inside a workspace?
What are we teaching users to do, and how are we teaching them?
What should a prompt entered in a chat box create by default?
5. Product model for Workspaces
What is the intended product model for Workspaces?
Is it primarily a governance, organization, and navigation layer, an app/project container, or all of these?
How should app, project, workspace, branch, and repository relate to one another?
What does “fully built and supported” mean in product terms?
6. Workspace technical and product seams
What key product and technical seams must be resolved for a first-class workspace flow?
Can a standalone app later move into a workspace or repository?
How should hosting, database, and deployment scope work across an app, project, and workspace?
If multiple apps live in one workspace, do they deploy together or share infrastructure?
7. Enterprise versus default workflow
Should Workspaces be an enterprise-first capability or a common default for Agent Native apps?
Does an individual using the framework without workspace templates need the same flow?
What is the minimum governance layer needed to make enterprise adoption viable?
Which parts should remain simple for self-serve users?
8. Workspace rollout and ownership
What is the incremental rollout plan and ownership for Workspaces?
What can ship now versus what requires a clean, first-class flow?
Should we introduce a new “space” type, or bridge incrementally from the current project model?
Who owns the design, engineering, and roadmap decisions, and by when?
9. GTM milestones and commitments
What milestones and dates can GTM safely communicate while the product scope is still evolving?
When can people get starter access?
When will the guided first-prompt experience be available?
When will Workspaces be first-class and usable without major hand-holding?
How do we set credible targets before every implementation detail is final?
10. Definition of an Agent Factory
What is an Agent Factory in our product terms?
How is it different from Zapier, n8n, Superblocks, or a visual agent/flow builder?
What distinct problem does it solve, and what is the product advantage?
11. First Factory user and use case
Who is the first Factory user, and what use case should we focus on?
Is the target product development, GTM, marketing, analytics, or enterprise teams more broadly?
Are current conversations biased toward product development because of customer self-selection?
What is the first wedge, and what personas or workflows are explicitly out of scope?
12. Factory growth and validation
What is the growth and validation plan for the Factory opportunity?
What evidence should we collect from PLG traction and enterprise demand?
Who owns narrowing the use cases, and what actions should happen next?
Is dogfooding plus targeted customer conversations enough to validate the opportunity?
13. Market hypothesis and decision status
Does the Factory concept fit our current market hypothesis, or does it change how we are approaching the market?
What is the current hypothesis?
Which assumptions are fixed, which need validation, and which remain open decision trees?
What evidence would cause us to double down, change direction, or stop?
14. Shared strategy and roadmap artifact
What shared strategy or roadmap artifact will keep product, engineering, and GTM aligned?
How should it communicate goals, priorities, sequencing, and what is intentionally not being built?
What discovery threshold is enough before committing more engineering resources?
How do we keep the organization informed without creating weekly roadmap churn?
